name: hcportal_createKennelRequestFromDraft
description: New kennel from a website (E12.F1.S10): turns the platform admin's finished AI draft into an ordinary kennel request in EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport (RequestStatus 1 — new and already confirmed, ConfirmedAt set, RequestSource 'website', SubmitterEmail = the caller's email), which is then reviewed and approved on the request page like any other (hcportal_approveKennelRequest). Nothing outside the request table is written. Called by the KennelFromWebsite API after it has copied the logo into blob storage. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with a NULL callerParamString. Gate: an HC.PlatformAdmin row (removed = 0) with CanEditKennel = 1. User text arrives NVARCHAR(MAX), is trimmed (blank becomes NULL) and checked with LEN against the column widths before anything is written. EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport has no file in db/schema/tables; its newer columns (LogoUrl, FoundedOn, RunDayOfWeek, RunStartTime, RunsPageUrl, SocialLinksJson, SourceJson, RequestSource) come from db/hc6/portal/archive/2026-10-10_kennel_from_website_columns.sql.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Portal token, validated with a NULL callerParamString. Caller must be an HC.PlatformAdmin with CanEditKennel.

parameters.name: cityId
parameters.description: When given, the place names come from our rows.

parameters.name: logoUrl
parameters.description: https; our blob copy (800x800 AVIF, PNG twin).

parameters.name: kennelImportId
parameters.description: Minted by the portal ONCE per draft page and sent on every Save (via the KennelFromWebsite API). Unknown id => the new request is stored under it; an id already stored for a website draft => success with that id, nothing written (a repeat after a lost reply); an id on a request that is not a website draft => error envelope. Default NULL = a fresh NEWID() as before.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always returned. Success = 0 with ErrorMessage on auth failure, missing platform-admin rights, a validation refusal, or the CATCH ('The request could not be saved. Please try again.'); no further rowset then. Success = 1, ErrorMessage NULL on insert.

rowsets.name: Created
rowsets.description: Success only: the new request's id, lowercase.

sideEffects: INSERT EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport (one row, RequestStatus 1, ConfirmAttempts 0, IsKennelAdmin 'Yes', NameToUse 'My Hash Name', HowDidYouLearnAboutHc 'Platform admin: New kennel from a website')
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on an unhandled error

A repeated @kennelImportId writes nothing. Note: EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport has no index on KennelImportId, so the locked check scans and range-locks the (small, platform-admin-only) table; a unique index would be James's call.

codeSmells.detail: Lines 165-166 store LEFT(@countryText/@regionText/@cityText, 50) without a LEN check in the validation block (lines 102-131), so a long free-text place name is cut rather than refused.

HC6.SocialLinksProblem (line 131), the TRY_CASTs and the place lookups (lines 140-146) run before BEGIN TRY; a runtime error there would be an unlogged 500. They are written not to throw, so this is exposure, not a known fault.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
changes: 1.2.0 (2026-10-14): optional @kennelImportId (idempotency audit P4; Idempotent writes: creates a row, client-id). The portal mints it once per draft page; an id already stored for a website draft (checked WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) inside the new transaction) returns success with that id and writes nothing; an id held by a non-website request is refused. NULL = the old behaviour (NEWID()).
